locator.title: Плиточный клей: 5 вопросов экспертам по ремонту
locator.lead: В статье — ответы экспертов на главные вопросы по плитке во время ремонта

nearest_text_before.text: Собрали 5 самых частых — с готовыми решениями.

nearest_text_after.text: Вопрос 1. Как подготовить основание из влагостойких ПГП под укладку плитки?

image_reading: Two installers use a rigid lifting frame with suction cups to hold a large vertical tile slab against a wall.
A wide strip of freshly combed tile adhesive remains visible along the slab’s right edge.
The slab is already close to its intended position, allowing only a small, controlled placement movement.
analysis.article_context: The article image introduces expert guidance on tile installation before the first technical question. It demonstrates the controlled placement of a large-format slab onto evenly combed adhesive, emphasizing correct technique, alignment, and reliable adhesion.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Correct tile installation depends on controlled technique and proper contact between the tile, adhesive, and prepared substrate.
structured_intent.primary_action: The installers guide and press the large-format slab into position against the adhesive-covered wall.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The slab is aligned, stable, and seated flush against the wall.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The placement remains a careful, professional installation procedure, with the slab continuously supported by both installers.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, use a fixed camera while both workers make one slow, coordinated placement movement through the lifting frame. The slab advances a few centimeters toward the combed adhesive at a steady pace; the motion gently decelerates as it seats. In the final frames, it is visibly aligned, stable, and flush against the wall, with both installers still supporting the frame.
models.positive_prompt: The two installers steadily guide the large slab a few centimeters toward the adhesive-covered wall using the lifting frame, then press it evenly into its aligned position. Their hands remain on the frame and the slab finishes stable and flush against the wall. Fixed camera.

models.scene_plan: For the full five-second shot, keep the camera fixed and let the installers steadily transfer pressure through the lifting frame. The large slab moves inward in one smooth, moderate-amplitude placement action, slowing naturally as its surface contacts and seats into the adhesive. It ends evenly aligned and flush, while the workers maintain controlled support.
models.positive_prompt: With a slow coordinated push on the lifting frame, the installers seat the large slab against the combed adhesive. The slab settles evenly and ends aligned, stable, and flush with the wall. Fixed camera.

models.scene_plan: Use a fixed four-second shot focused on a compact final seating movement. The two installers apply a smooth, coordinated inward push through the frame; the slab travels only a short distance and settles against the adhesive without abrupt gestures. The last frame clearly shows it aligned, stable, and flush against the wall.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. The installers smoothly press the large slab inward with the lifting frame, seating it against the combed adhesive. By the final frame, the slab is aligned, stable, and flush with the wall.
